rows.grounds: locative compound indicating position in front of Śiva
locative compound referring to Śiva's left side
locative compound specifying placement on the pure earth level

items.question: What alternative locations are permissible for situating the pericarp?
premises: The pericarp may be situated in front of Śiva.
Alternatively, the pericarp may be situated at his left side.
The pericarp may also be placed on the left upon the pure earth ground.
items.inference: Multiple alternative locations are valid for the placement of the pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise referent of 'his' in tadvāme is inferred from the preceding mention of Śiva.
items.plain_english: It may be placed in front of Śiva, or else at his left, or on the left upon the pure earth ground.
